text:
anita: Opening a small docs PR to refresh the Quickstart onboarding flow. Goals: add a minimal PHP example, standardize on REDWOOD_API_KEY + REDWOOD_ENDPOINT placeholders, and remove an outdated 'publish' step. PR: http://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pull/4388. Asking for devex review.

docs-bot: PR #4388 opened by anita  CI queued.

kevin: Can you keep the PHP example minimal (curl + file_put_contents style) and include a one-line note about using a secrets manager in prod?

anita: Yep, will do. Also found a stray anchor link in quickstart/setup.md and will fix it in this PR.

olga: Quick nit: ensure all code fences have language tags (```php) and no concrete hostnames.

ci-bot: markdown-lint flagged heading level inconsistency; small fix applied.

anita: Pushed fixes: added PHP snippet, fixed anchor, added KMS note, normalized env var usage. Staging preview: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/preview/4388

preview-bot: Preview published  please sanity-check snippets.

kevin: Reviewed and approved, small formatting nit fixed.

ci-bot: CI passed  link-check OK.

docs-bot: PR #4388 merged by anita (:rocket:).

olga: Thanks all  this should make onboarding smoother for PHP users.
